effects.description: [On Play] Add up to 1 red Character card other than [Uta] with a cost of 3 or less from your trash to your hand.
conditions: This Character is played onto the field
steps: Choose 1 red Character card from your trash that costs 3 or less and is not named [Uta]
(Optional) Add that chosen card to your hand
notes: This effect activates automatically when this Character is played
You don't have to choose a card if you don't want to
